Chart labels use a smaller sans-serif/Type3 subsystem and local categorical palettes. Across objects, method/domain order is stable, while uncertainty notation and exact denominator definitions are usually absent from captions.

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. While standard RL performs policy gradient updates during training using previous trajectories, JitRL operates at test time. Specifically, it retrieves trajectories relevant to the current state to estimate advantages A, subsequently refining the output logits through a KL-regularized policy optimization objective.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. Overview of the Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL) framework. The system operates in a continuous loop: (1) In the Inference (top), the agent retrieves relevant past experiences N(s) from the non-parametric memory M. The base LLM’s logits z are then adjusted in closed-form (z′ = z + β Â) using the estimated advantage Â derived from historical returns, enabling test-time policy improvement without gradient updates. (2) In the Memory Update (bottom), completed trajectories are analyzed by an evaluator to compute discounted returns Gt. These new experiences are stored back into M, allowing the agent to evolve its policy across episodes.

color.semantic_mapping: Inference 区域使用浅桃色、Memory Update 使用浅蓝色；蓝/橙/绿/红小图与柱状块分别表示 logits、value、advantage 及正负调整，图标颜色区分环境、生成器和 evaluator。

encodings.x: Inference 上部从 Environments/State 经 Generator、Memory、Value/Advantage Estimation 到 Updated Logits 由左向右；Memory Update 下部反向从 Complete Trajectory 到 Step-wise Returns。
encodings.y: 上层与下层色带区分在线推理与回合结束后的记忆更新。
encodings.color: 浅桃/浅蓝编码两条大流程；蓝色 logits、橙色 value、绿色 advantage、红色负向/强调标记。
encodings.shape: 圆角区域、节点框、数据库与机器人图标、柱状 logits/advantage、汇合圆点和箭头。
encodings.line: 实线箭头表示 state→action/logit 流；虚线箭头表示 trajectory/store/returns 的记忆回路。
encodings.facet: Inference 与 Memory Update 两个主要区域，内部依次标注 Environments、Experiences、Value Estimation、Advantage Estimation 等。
encodings.text: z(s,a)、Q̂(s,a)、V̂(s)、Â、z′=z+βÂ、Gt 及候选/返回三元组直接标注。

figures.data_and_statistics: 方法接口示意图，不展示实验样本或不确定性；上部用 top-k memory retrieval 估计 state/action value 和 advantage 并调整 logits，下部用 evaluator 生成 step-wise rewards/discounted returns 后写回 memory。
figures.evidence_relation: 承接 Figure 1 右侧机制，逐步连接方法第 4 节的 memory construction、value estimation、policy update 与 Appendix A Algorithm 1；Tables 7/17 的 logit 改变案例和 Tables 19–23 的参数/可扩展性切片回溯该接口。
design_strengths: 把 inference 与 memory update 放在同一连续回路，清楚表达“跨 episode 变好”的状态转移。
公式、经验三元组和柱状 logit/advantage 示例共同建立抽象变量到操作的映射。
实线与虚线区分即时决策流和回合后存储流，阅读方向稳定。
design_weaknesses: 节点和数学标注密集，缩小后柱状块、虚线回路和公式容易互相竞争。
颜色语义没有单独 legend，读者需依赖邻近文字判断蓝/橙/绿/红含义。
caption 解释闭环但未说明 top-k 的实际取值、候选集合构造或 evaluator 的误差边界。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用双色上下分区、实线/虚线双流和局部数值示例，把“推理时修改”和“回合后写回”画成一个闭环方法接口。

figures.evidence_relation: Table 3 的 Avg/Final 汇总被展开为 episode 级时间轨迹；正文用它支持 JitRL 快速学习、后期差距扩大和方差降低的机制叙述，Appendix Table 14 提供同 backbone 的 GRPO 对照。
design_strengths: 三游戏共享横轴和方法顺序，能直接看到 JitRL 的增长速度与不同 reward 上限。

各 panel y 轴范围不同，跨游戏的绝对高度不能直接比较。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用同一方法 palette 的多任务 small multiples，把 Avg/Final 表扩展成逐 episode 轨迹；复用时应补充重复与不确定性定义。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1. Main results on WebArena. We report average (Avg) and final (Final) success rate (%) for each domain. The gap between Final and Avg reflects learning efficiency. The final column (Average) is calculated as the micro-average across all tasks from all websites.

tables.uncertainty: 未显示 error bar、区间或标准差；表内数值为单点汇总，具体重复/分母仅按 caption 或正文说明记录。
tables.data_and_statistics: WebArena 五个网站（Admin、GitLab、Map、Reddit、Shopping）各有 Avg/Final 两列，另给 Average Avg/Final；百分比按任务/尝试汇总，caption 指明 Average 为跨所有网站任务的 micro-average。6 个方法行，JitRL 行加粗；没有不确定性或失败值列。

design_strengths: 跨网站和 Avg/Final 的双层表头把任务维度与学习阶段放在同一阅读面。
booktabs 横线、方法列左对齐、数值列整齐，JitRL 加粗突出主结论。

design_weaknesses: 表头宽度较大，窄版阅读时 12 列数值密集。
只用加粗突出 JitRL，没有不确定性或每列样本数。
不同网站的任务数/分母未在表内给出，micro-average 的构成需回正文。
tables.reusable_pattern: 以双层域分组表头同时报告过程均值与最终结果，适合主比较；复用时在表注补充分母和重复定义.

tables.reusable_pattern: 用参数行×域列的轻量矩阵保留异质性；若需决策应补充 Average 或预注册选择规则.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 frames the training-time versus test-time contrast; Figure 2 turns the test-time idea into an inference/memory-update loop; Tables 1–3 and Figure 3 establish WebArena/Jericho headline performance and learning trajectories; Tables 4–9 isolate backbone generalization, cross-task memory, qualitative corrections, update-interface ablation and cost; Appendix Tables 10–24 and Figure 5 provide settings, controls, representation/parameter sensitivity, scalability and GRPO sweep evidence.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions use italic Figure/Table labels followed by short serif prose. Figure 2 and qualitative Tables 7/17 add a bold descriptive title and more encoding explanation; most line-plot and appendix captions are short and omit uncertainty, sample/repetition definitions and axis interpretation. Caption wording generally states comparison/setup but only selected objects state a main finding.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Performance tables group domains or games in multi-level headers and use Avg/Final or Avg Score labels; appendix control tables use single-level Method/domain headers, while hyperparameter tables use Category/Parameter/Value. Row groups are signaled by horizontal rules and italic section labels. Costs are sometimes placed beside performance in Tables 9 and 13.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: The Figure 2 variables memory, value, advantage and logit update reappear as Table 7/17 Base→JitRL qualitative changes, Table 8 Prompt versus Logit Update, Figure 4 k sensitivity, Figure 5 state representation, Tables 19–22 λ/α sensitivity and Table 23 memory scaling. Figure 3/Table 3 provide the primary Jericho trajectory/summary link.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main Tables 1–9 and Figures 1–4 cite or are expanded by Appendix Tables 10–24 and Figure 5: hyperparameters (10–11), same-backbone controls (12–14), unified pipeline (15–16), qualitative transfer (17), steps/cost/scalability (18, 23), λ/α ablations (19–22), and GRPO sweep (24).
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Serif table/body typography and horizontal rules are stable across main and appendix. Figure 1/2 conceptual assets use larger serif labels, while Figures 3–5 use smaller sans-serif chart labels with serif captions. PDF font objects support the family observations, but estimated figure sizes come from the 180 dpi rendering.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Color is local rather than global: Figure 3 method colors are not reused for Figure 5 representations, and qualitative red/green text has a separate correctness meaning. Position, titles, line style and bold text provide partial redundancy, but several quantitative charts still depend on color for series identity.

most_reusable_patterns: 用并列概念面板先固定“传统训练 vs 测试时优化”的接口，再用跨环境表格和轨迹图逐层量化。
在性能表中稳定复用 domain/game 分组表头、Avg/Final 语义和粗体最佳行，使主结果、控制比较和附录切片可对齐。
用两行动作 qualitative table 展示 Base→JitRL logit 变化并给出机制解释，把抽象更新公式连接到可读案例。
将关键消融按参数×环境矩阵成对放置（Jericho/WebArena），保留局部异质性而不只给单一均值。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：同时表达 inference 与 memory update 的闭环，是方法接口和后续所有消融的视觉枢纽。
Table 1：五域 Avg/Final 主比较，把 headline success-rate 证据压缩到一张可扫描的宽表。
Figure 3 + Table 3：逐 episode 曲线与 Avg/Final 汇总互补，支撑 JitRL 学习速度和最终能力叙述。
Table 7 与 Appendix Table 17：Base/JitRL logits 和机制解释提供定性因果链。
failure_patterns: 多数图表不报告重复次数、误差或分母；Figure 3/4/5 的稳定性和波动主张主要依赖单条点估计轨迹。
量化图表大量依赖颜色，Figure 3 的七方法和 Figure 4/5 的两系列在灰度/色觉缺陷下冗余不足。
成本表把 GPU 训练费用与 API 推理费用放在同一比较面，附录虽有拆解但主表口径并不完全同质。
部分 caption 只给标题而不定义 axis、聚合或不确定性，脱离正文后不能完整复现证据边界。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以“概念对照→闭环接口→跨环境主比较→机制/成本消融→附录控制与复现”推进，依靠稳定的 serif/booktabs 表格骨架和局部 categorical 图色把 JitRL 的测试时记忆、logit 更新及效率主张连成一条视觉证据链。
